sample_label: Rendered notification archive interaction and responsive observation
independence: Non-independent verification in the implementation context using compiler, rendered DOM, screenshots and console sensors.

measurements.raw_evidence: A uniquely identified read notification disappeared from ALL after archive without route navigation; unread badge remained 2.

measurements.sensor: Authenticated browser archived-view and restore interaction
measurements.raw_evidence: The archived item displayed its archive time and restore action; restore returned it to ALL while unread remained 2.
Archive-all-read opened a dedicated confirmation explaining that unread messages are unaffected; cancellation left data unchanged.
limitation: The destructive confirmation was cancelled to avoid relocating the current user's full read history; bulk mutation semantics are covered by backend tests.

measurements.sensor: Rendered DOM metrics and screenshots at desktop, 375x812, 390x844 and 430x932
measurements.raw_evidence: Three tabs, module filter, notification content and item actions remained usable; document and articles had no horizontal overflow and tabs fit every viewport.
